concept: Volunteering to help with a group task, even one that isn't glamorous or fun
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character volunteers for an unglamorous task (like cleaning up) that needs doing, even though it's not the fun job
exercise.reflection_prompt: Why did the character choose the less fun job?
exercise.practice: Student names an unglamorous task they could volunteer for

assessment.success_marker: student names a real, specific, unglamorous task
